description: This line chart, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the variation in three performance metrics—precision, recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," is linear and categorical, displaying the variants in order: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", is linear and scaled from 58% to 66%, with tick marks at every 0.5% interval. Three distinct lines represent each metric: precision is shown with a purple line and circular markers, recall with a blue line and circular markers, and F1-score with a brown line and circular markers. The chart begins at the "Full model (Ours)" with precision at 65.45%, recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.56%. As the model variants progress, precision declines to 65.44% at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Recall decreases from 65.78% to 56.82%, and F1-score decreases from 65.56% to 57.74%. The lines show a general downward trend across the model variants, with precision and recall showing a slight dip and then a partial recovery before declining further, while F1-score consistently declines.
